description: Implement streaming/OBS support architecture, wallpaper engine compatibility layer, community features architecture, plugin system, and final integration ensuring the complete application builds and all systems work together.
steps: Create src/plugins/types.ts - Plugin interface (id, name, version, init, destroy, onAudioUpdate, onRender). Define PluginContext with access to audio state, render engine, scene manager
Create src/plugins/PluginManager.ts - load/unload plugins, manage plugin lifecycle, provide sandboxed context to plugins, emit events to plugins
Create src/plugins/index.ts exporting plugin system
Create src/community/types.ts - CommunityPreset, UserProfile, Rating interfaces for future community features

Create src/community/CommunityManager.ts - stub implementation with methods: browsePresets(), uploadPreset(), ratePreset(), downloadPreset(). Currently returns mock data but architecture is ready for API integration
Create src/community/index.ts exporting community module

Create src/config/streaming.ts - StreamingConfig with modes: normal, obs-optimized (higher bitrate, stable FPS), transparent-background (alpha channel rendering), chroma-key (solid green/blue background), ui-hidden (no overlay rendering), wallpaper (borderless, always-behind, low-CPU)

Create src/config/wallpaper.ts - WallpaperConfig for Wallpaper Engine compatibility: transparent rendering, reduced FPS mode, system tray only, auto-start, respond to Wallpaper Engine properties protocol

Create src/main/ipc-handlers.ts - Electron IPC handlers for: audio device enumeration, system audio capture via desktopCapturer, window mode changes (fullscreen, transparent, always-on-top, frameless), file dialogs for preset import/export, system tray management
Create src/main/tray.ts - system tray with quick actions: toggle visualizer, change scene, change preset, quit
Create src/ui/panels/StreamingPanel.tsx - UI panel for streaming mode selection, background options (transparent, chroma key, custom color), performance preset for streaming
Create src/ui/panels/WallpaperPanel.tsx - UI panel for wallpaper mode settings: FPS limit, CPU usage target, start with system toggle
Create src/ui/components/BackgroundSelector.tsx - select background: solid color, gradient, image upload, video, GIF, transparent. Store in config
Create src/effects/BackgroundRenderer.ts - render custom backgrounds (images, videos, GIFs, gradients) behind the Three.js scene using a separate layer or background plane
Create src/effects/OverlayRenderer.ts - render overlays on top of scenes: center logo, custom text, image overlays with positioning
Update src/core/Engine.ts to integrate: PluginManager, BackgroundRenderer, OverlayRenderer, streaming modes
Update src/renderer/App.tsx to include StreamingPanel and WallpaperPanel in the control UI
Create src/config/keyboard-shortcuts.ts - complete keyboard shortcut map that is user-configurable
Create src/utils/export.ts - utility to export current frame as PNG, export animation as GIF/WebM (architecture only, using canvas capture)
Ensure all modules have proper index.ts barrel exports
Final integration: verify all imports resolve, all types are consistent across modules, no circular dependencies

Create comprehensive README.md with: project overview, architecture diagram (text), installation (pnpm install), development (pnpm dev), building (pnpm build), features list, keyboard shortcuts, customization guide, plugin development guide, streaming setup guide
acceptance_criteria: PluginManager supports loading plugins with typed interfaces
CommunityManager provides stubbed API for future community features
Streaming modes are configurable and stored in config
IPC handlers bridge main and renderer processes properly
All modules have proper barrel exports with no circular dependencies
Full project builds successfully with pnpm build
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
findings: All 71 existing tests pass. Build succeeds with tsc and vite. The streaming modes are config-only as documented. The community module is stubbed for future API integration. Tray icon uses a base64 PNG placeholder. GlobalState was extended with streamingMode field to support Engine integration.
